modules.label: Billing & Payments
modules.description: Checkout, transactions, credits purchase UI, payment webhooks, and a usage ledger with a /usage dashboard: spend by meter, rates, balance history and threshold alerts.

modules.label: Organizations / Teams
modules.description: Workspaces, member invites, workspace switching, and owner/admin/member/viewer roles.

modules.label: AI Platform
modules.description: Chat UI, prompt management, multi-provider abstraction, speech (TTS/STT), and token-aware credit metering.

modules.label: AI Agents & RAG (Python)
modules.description: FastAPI service with LangGraph agents, background AI jobs, RAG collections over pgvector, and the streaming agent proxy. Requires the AI Platform.

modules.label: API Keys
modules.description: Scoped API keys users create in Settings, hashed at rest, with per-key rate limits and an /api/v1/me endpoint.

modules.label: Background jobs & cron
modules.description: Typed background jobs on Inngest with retries, a dead-letter queue and replay, cron schedules, and email sent through the queue. Without it, jobs run inline.

modules.label: Notifications
modules.description: An in-app bell and inbox on web, desktop and mobile, per-type email and in-app preferences, and email delivered as a background job. Ships with payment, low-credit and invitation events.

modules.label: Audit log
modules.description: An append-only trail of admin, invitation, organization, API key, CMS and prompt changes, with filters and CSV export at /admin/audit, workspace activity for organization admins, and retention set in Settings.

modules.label: Outgoing webhooks
modules.description: Customer-managed webhook endpoints with HMAC-signed, versioned events, retries with backoff for 24 hours, a delivery log with replay, secret rotation and SSRF protection. Requires background jobs.

modules.label: Feature flags
modules.description: Per-user feature flags evaluated on the server: role, user, workspace and percentage rules, an admin page with rule editor, preview and history, useFlag() in the UI and flagProcedure() to enforce them. Without it every flag keeps its code default.

modules.label: Onboarding
modules.description: A skippable welcome wizard and a setup checklist whose tasks come from the modules you pick (profile, team invite, credits, first AI chat, API key), completed from real data. Toggle both in Settings.
